title: Case 1: Active Peptic Ulcer + NSAID (Critical Contraindication)
clinical_conditions: History of recurrent active peptic ulcer disease with upper GI bleeding 6 months ago; Osteoarthritis knee pain.
notes: Patient requesting strong pain relief for knee inflammation.

title: Case 2: Accidental Acetaminophen Overdose (Hepatotoxicity Warning)
clinical_conditions: Acute viral bronchitis with high fever and muscle aches; Moderate alcohol consumption (3-4 drinks/weekend).
current_medications: Over-the-counter Tylenol Extra Strength 500mg tablets (takes 2 tablets every 4 hours = 6000mg/day)

prescribed_rx.frequency: Every 4 hours as needed for fever

notes: Patient does not realize prescription combines with their existing OTC acetaminophen, exceeding the 4000mg/day absolute safe ceiling.

title: Case 3: Statin + Food-Drug Interaction (Rhabdomyolysis Risk)
clinical_conditions: Hyperlipidemia, primary hypercholesterolemia, coronary artery disease risk.
notes: Patient drinks 1 to 1.5 liters of freshly squeezed grapefruit juice every morning for breakfast.

title: Case 4: Severe Renal Impairment + Metformin (Lactic Acidosis)
clinical_conditions: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus, Stage 4 Chronic Kidney Disease (latest estimated GFR = 24 mL/min/1.73 m²).
notes: Prescription renewal request. Lab tests show eGFR declined from 38 to 24 mL/min.

title: Case 5: Penicillin Anaphylaxis + Amoxicillin (Severe Allergy)
clinical_conditions: Acute bacterial sinusitis with facial pressure and purulent nasal discharge.
known_allergies: Severe Penicillin allergy (developed anaphylaxis and facial angioedema in childhood).
notes: Doctor prescribed first-line antibiotic without verifying allergy record.

title: Case 6: Routine Bacterial Pharyngitis (Safe Prescription)
clinical_conditions: Streptococcal pharyngitis (Strep throat confirmed by rapid antigen test).
known_allergies: No known drug allergies (NKDA). Normal renal and hepatic function.
notes: Standard approved first-line regimen. Patient instructed to finish entire 10-day course.
